title: Staging Recovery Storage 驗收與 Rollout 映射矩陣
purpose: 明確分離前置 Storage Readiness（Stage A）與 Release Rehearsal Bundle 實際生成/驗收（Stage B，由 ODP-EPHEMERAL-STAGING-ROLLOUT-001 承接），確保歷史依賴具名承接、執行步驟明確且所有驗收項目與缺口如實披露。

stage_a_pre_deployment_storage_readiness.scope: 核對已合併儲存契約、分離守門規則、GitHub staging 環境變數與身分座標、CMEK/Versioning/Retention/PAP/UBLA/IAM 安全基準、唯讀審計收據及環境綁定前置條件。不執行雲端資源建立或修改。因 active auto worker 服務帳號 (oday-dev-runtime@alfaloop-data-project-2.iam.gserviceaccount.com) 跨專案缺少 staging 專案 (odayplus-runtime-20260825) 之 IAM 權限 (storage.buckets.get, storage.buckets.getIamPolicy, cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get)，GCP 雲端探針返回 IAM_DENIED。依驗收標準與 review 要求，Stage A 保持 INCOMPLETE/BLOCKED，等待 Human/Ops 提供授權唯讀身分或資源 owner 簽署之 metadata 收據，不假造通過亦不推斷儲存桶缺失。

stage_b_release_rehearsal_bundle_lifecyc.phase_name: Stage B: Release Rehearsal Bundle Lifecycle & Drill
stage_b_release_rehearsal_bundle_lifecyc.scope: 於 Ephemeral Staging 部署演練時實際建立短生命週期環境、生成 release-scoped recovery bundle（*.tfvars.json、*.inventory.json、*.lifecycle.json 與 staging-terraform-outputs.json）、計算本地 content SHA-256、上傳至 GCS recovery bucket、捕捉並綁定 GCS object generation、以指定 generation 驗證遠端內容 SHA-256 一致性、涵蓋 hold 狀態重寫後之 new generation 追蹤、執行 backup/restore、Cloud Run traffic rollback 與 rerun identity guard 驗證、並在 watch window 結束後依 exact labels 自動清理。不預設 rehearsal bundle 於 rehearsal 前已存在。注意：snapshot-pointer restore 尚未在 staging_lifecycle.py 實作，列為原 rollout task 之顯式驗收缺口。

criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: Executable Stage B protocol for ODP-EPHEMERAL-STAGING-ROLLOUT-001: 1. Schema Limitation: GCS standard object metadata does NOT provide a native content SHA-256 field (crc32c is not SHA-256, and customerEncryption.keySha256 is the encryption key hash, not payload hash). 2. Hash Computation: Before uploading each sidecar (*.tfvars.json, *.inventory.json, *.lifecycle.json, staging-terraform-outputs.json), compute local content SHA-256 (e.g. sha256sum or python hashlib.sha256). 3. Upload & Generation Capture: Upload each sidecar to STAGING_BUNDLE_URI via gcloud storage cp; immediately capture authoritative GCS integer generation via 'gcloud storage objects describe ${STAGING_BUNDLE_URI}/<sidecar> --format=value(generation)'. Assert generation is non-empty positive integer. 4. Content Verification: Read back remote object at the pinned generation (${STAGING_BUNDLE_URI}/<sidecar>#<generation>), compute downloaded content SHA-256, and assert remote_sha256 == local_sha256. 5. Receipt Recording: Record per-object receipt {object_uri, generation, content_sha256, size_bytes, uploaded_at, secret_values_redacted: true} in staging-lifecycle-create.json and staging-rehearsal-receipt.json. 6. Hold State Rewrite: When staging fails and enters hold (deploy-dev.yml:1324-1334), staging_lifecycle.py hold updates *.lifecycle.json. Recompute local SHA-256, re-upload to STAGING_BUNDLE_URI, capture NEW GCS generation (assert new_generation > initial_generation), verify remote SHA-256 at new generation, and update receipt. 7. Required Permission: roles/storage.objectUser on recovery bucket for github-deployer SA. 8. Fail-Closed Policy: Rehearsal MUST fail closed if any sidecar is missing, generation is missing/zero, SHA-256 mismatch occurs, or unauthorized generation drift is detected. Bundles are created and verified during authorized Stage B rehearsal, not beforehand.

summary_disposition.conclusion: 前置 Storage Readiness（Stage A）中，代碼契約、分離守門規則、GitHub staging 環境變數座標（2026-09-19 live readback 驗證全部 BOUND）與收據去敏化契約已完成核對（CRIT-01, CRIT-02, CRIT-06 為 VERIFIED_READY）。然而，針對 runtime 服務帳號執行 GCP 唯讀探針因跨專案缺乏 staging 權限遭遇 IAM_DENIED（CRIT-03, CRIT-04, CRIT-05），依驗收規範與審查判定，Stage A 保持 INCOMPLETE / BLOCKED，等待 Human/Ops 提供授權唯讀身分或 signed metadata 收據，不假造通過。Stage B 之 Release Rehearsal 執行期驗收項目（CRIT-07 至 CRIT-10）已具備可執行命令、流程接點（包含 CRIT-08 完整之本地 content SHA-256 計算、GCS generation 捕捉、指定 generation 遠端 SHA-256 比對、hold 狀態重寫後之 generation 追蹤與 fail-closed 條件；CRIT-09 之 Cloud SQL backup/restore 與 Cloud Run rollback）、權限要求、pass/fail 條件與 snapshot-pointer restore 顯式缺口揭露，完整映射至 ODP-EPHEMERAL-STAGING-ROLLOUT-001（Owner: Antigravity5, Reviewer: Codex）。
